The Jalan Petaling neighborhood, located in the heart of Kuala Lumpur, refers to the neighborhoods of Jalan Sultan, Jalan Tun H. S. Lee, Jalan Panggung, Jalan Tun Tan Cheng Lock and others adjacent to Jalan Petaling. Jalan Tun Tan Cheng Lock. This century-old neighborhood has witnessed the rise and fall of Kuala Lumpur through the ages. Confucian Private Secondary School, built next to Petaling Street, the surrounding neighborhood has become a street and a field for the students to traverse on a daily basis. The “Petaling Street Community” is a local history of the evolution of the community, presented by the Confucian Private Secondary School‘s Multimedia Creation Society (MCS) newsletter team, who are the most familiar participants in the evolution of the community. Through field visits, they used the Petaling Street neighborhood as a pivot point to record an era.
